stem.alt: Energy cycle: CH4 + 2O2 at the top; arrow X runs down-left to C + 2H2 + 2O2; arrow Y runs down-right to CO2 + 2H2O; horizontal arrow Z runs from C + 2H2 + 2O2 to CO2 + 2H2O.

stem.text: The energy changes involved are $X$, $Y$ and $Z$.
The numerical value of energy change $Y$ is either $-890$ or $+890$.
The numerical value of energy change $Z$ is either $-964$ or $+964$.
Which of the three values are negative?
